Seal.Good.detail: Contract repaired: DH uses 32-byte private keys; AEAD uses a 32-byte key, 24-byte nonce, plaintext below 274877906817 bytes and associated data below 2^64 bytes. The payload bound accounts for the stream cipher's ceiling to complete or partial blocks, beyond the outer AEAD check. Public keys and hashes supply 32-byte outputs. Concrete production equalities and malformed-input regressions pass; the universal native cryptographic contract remains an explicit unproved assumption, not a finite-test conclusion.

openSealed_seal.detail: Correctly scoped theorem applied to concrete 32-byte private/content keys, 24-byte nonce and supported payload/associated-data sizes. Key/nonce/payload premises have kernel proofs; hashed key-id/associated-data sizes and real native DH, wrapping and message roundtrips pass executable checks. The universal cryptoSeal.Good premise remains conditional; former malformed-key/nonce counterexamples are outside the repaired contract.
